menu.subtitle: Mod settings
showWn8.body: Display WN8 rating in the TAB team table
showWinrate.body: Display win rate percentage in the TAB team table
showBattles.body: Display the number of battles in the TAB team table
battleResultsDeanonimize.body: Show real player names instead of anonymized names in Battle Results
panelDisplayMode.body: Show player-panel statistics and coloring always or only while Alt is held
panelWinratePosition.body: Choose where the selected statistic is shown in the player panels
panelMetric.body: Choose which statistic is shown in the player panels
panelWinrateFontSize.body: Adjust the font size of the statistic in the player panels
panelHorizontalOffset.body: Adjust the horizontal position of the statistic near the vehicle icon
panelValueFormat.body: Show win rate with decimals or as a whole number
ratingMode.body: Choose overall WN8 or WN8 for the latest 1000 battles
wgApiRegion.body: Server region used for WG Public API requests
colorizePanelText.body: Color stock nicknames and vehicle names in player panels using the selected metric
panelTextColorMetric.body: Choose which statistic controls nickname and vehicle-name colors
showAnonymizerIcon.body: Show an anonymizer icon for players whose statistics cannot be resolved
